graft.title: Say when a baseline file exists but isn't recorded
graft.need: `tend baseline license choose|show` says 'vg-paradigms has no licensing (licensing/combos.toml)' when the file is committed at the pinned rev but missing from the baseline's signed document log (Source::read returns None for DOC_DIRS paths not in the log). The message should say the file is there but unrecorded, and that `tend doc record` in the baseline records it; `tend baseline check` in a project could warn the same way.
graft.use_case: Adopting Tend in autodyne: the misleading message cost a dig through tend-core's Source::read to find the cause.

answer.text: Done in tend 9facf9e. In a baseline repo, every document under its document folders that's added or edited since it was recorded is a contract error, so `tend baseline check` and `tend check --strict` (CI) fail until `tend doc record` runs there. In a project, `tend baseline check` warns (baseline.recorded) and lists them, and a command that needs one, like `tend baseline license`, says it's there but not recorded and where to record it, instead of 'has no licensing'. vg-paradigms' licensing and workflows are recorded now (its batch 01a109fe), so autodyne's switch is unblocked once that batch is committed there.
